from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def M(p,e,t):
    A=p[0]+p[1]*t; k=p[2]+p[3]*t; r0=p[4]+p[5]*t; c=p[6]+p[7]*t
    x=e-r0
    return c+A*(np.exp(-2*k*x)-2*np.exp(-k*x))
